rows.grounds: abstract state of being Brahma; object of abandonment
subject or locus characterized by the following quality
compound adjective: dhīvara (fisherman) + ātmaka (having-nature); qualifies citta

items.question: What condition was relinquished when the mind took on a fisherman's nature?
premises: At that time Brahma-state was abandoned.
The abandonment is presented as a direct consequence of that mental condition.
items.inference: Assuming a fisherman's nature entails the loss of the Brahma-state.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic agency of citta with the passive participle tyaktaṃ is contextually inferred.
items.plain_english: Then indeed the Brahma-state was abandoned, as the mind became fisherman-natured.
